text_en: It was narrated that Amr - meaning, bin Umar - said: "The Messenger of Allah came and circumambulated the House seven times, then he prayed two Rakahs behind the Maqam and performed Sai between As-Safa and Al-Marwah, and he said: 'Indeed in the Messenger of Allah you have a good example to follow."
text_id: Telah mengabarkan kepada kami [Qutaibah], ia berkata; telah menceritakan kepada kami [Sufyan] dari ['Amr], [Ibnu Umar] berkata; Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam datang kemudian melakukan thawaf di Ka'bah tujuh kali, dan melakukan shalat di belakang Maqam dua rakaat, serta melakukan thawaf antara Shafa dan Marwah. Dan Ibnu Umar berkata; "Sungguh bagi kalian dalam diri Rasulullah terdapat suri tauladan yang baik."
